proof_roadmap: Reduce structure group etale-locally to small good-reduction open subgroups.
Linearize congruence quotients using exponential/BCH estimates.
Lift trivializations successively and pass through the Milnor exact sequence.
Combine vanishing with retained full faithfulness.
difficulty_reason: The retained core descends nonabelian quotient sheaves G/U even for non-normal U through perfectoid tilde-limits, proves etale-local reduction via sections of associated coset bundles, and combines cotangent-complex approximation with quantitative BCH congruences and successive lifting. A Mittag-Leffler/Milnor argument then trivializes small torsors. These constructions and bridges, not merely the terminal six-line application or advanced terminology, support H2. All supporting results remain one proof chain.
difficulty_assessment_limits: H2 supported; H3 not asserted. Classical exponential background remains accurately cited external input with its author sketch. No independent correctness certification.
